{{Infobox auto}}

'''Glow berry mash''' is the simple preparation of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. It heals {{Value|Glow Berry Mash|heals}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 3 seconds, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/glow_mash.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Glow berries cook into glow berry mash in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Glow Berry Mash|cook_time}}. Picking up glow berries unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating glow berry mash takes {{Value|Glow Berry Mash|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Glow Berry Mash|heals}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 3 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/3s.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Glow Berries#Aura]].

Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks [[Glow Berry Jam|glow berry jam]] and [[Glow Berry Crumble|glow berry crumble]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Glow berry mash works.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|The aura is triggered by the mash's own custom data instead of the rotten flesh model, so vanilla rotten flesh no longer triggers it.}}
{{History line|1.12.4|2=Glow berry mash made in this version gave no aura. It carries a <code>version</code> number in its custom data, and the advancement that starts the aura required the custom data to be exactly the aura marker.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/3s.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/glow_mash.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.5|2=Fixed: the aura advancement only checks that the custom data contains the aura marker, so glow berry mash gives its aura again.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Glow Berry Jam and Mash fixed}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/3s.json}}</ref>}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Glow berry mash is a renamed rotten flesh. In 1.12.2 the aura was triggered by eating anything with the rotten flesh model, so vanilla rotten flesh also triggered it; since 1.12.3 it checks for the mash's own custom data.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/3s.json}}</ref> Since 1.12.4 the automatic item updater gives any rotten flesh held in a hand the mash's tooltip, effects and aura marker, so vanilla rotten flesh becomes a working glow berry mash.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/glow_mash.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/item_modifier/modify/glow_mash.json}}</ref>
